Method of Attack: Cryptomining malware installed on compromised NAS devices to mine cryptocurrency
Hides mining process and CPU memory usage to evade detection via web management interface
Discoverer: Qihoo 360's Network Security Research Lab (360 Netlab)
Impacted Systems: QNAP NAS devices with firmware released before August 2020
Attack Vector: Exploitation of two pre-auth remote command execution (RCE) vulnerabilities in the Helpdesk app
